name: MEV bot 0xa47b unguarded callback
summary: The MEV bot accepted an unauthenticated Balancer flash-loan callback and delegated execution to addresses supplied through callback calldata. The attacker made that path transfer the bot's WETH to attacker-controlled code and used the proceeds in an arbitrage transaction.
notes: The bot address was an operator-controlled metamorphic CREATE2 slot. After the previous runtime self-destructed, this transaction recreated the address with the 556-byte runtime later exploited. It was the last of 17 successful creations before the incident, and the runtime remained byte-identical through exploitation.

The exploit receipt shows 187.745915823040341329 WETH leaving the bot for attacker-controlled helper 0x2d0037e6e417baef5adc0d521dd127e724279bfe. A 1 WETH Balancer flash-loan transfer into the bot and its 1 WETH repayment cancel, leaving the same exact net bot depletion. No recovery is netted.
